headline: Week 1: all three rivals rated low threat; StockSathi's ₹499 Basic and ₹999 Pro are the price benchmarks to watch.
tl_dr: StockSathi's Basic (₹499/month, 500 items, GST billing) and Pro (₹999/month, unlimited items, GST billing) are the lowest entry prices tracked this week [StockSathi-1-1][StockSathi-1-2].
StockSathi's recent launches are low impact: 2G sync with 40% smaller payloads, and dark mode [StockSathi-1-4][StockSathi-1-5].
ShelfMitra's new purchase-order approvals target multi-store chains, not single kirana stores [ShelfMitra-1-4].
All of ShelfMitra's open roles are in Mumbai: 2 Backend Engineers and 1 Product Designer [ShelfMitra-1-5][ShelfMitra-1-6].
BahiBook's 50,000-user base is reported in Maharashtra, with no Kolkata evidence [BahiBook-1-4].
since_last_week: First brief: no earlier week to compare.

threats.rationale: This week's StockSathi signals are baseline pricing that cannot show change, low-impact 2G sync and dark mode launches, and two Bengaluru hiring listings [StockSathi-1-1][StockSathi-1-2][StockSathi-1-3][StockSathi-1-4][StockSathi-1-5][StockSathi-1-6][StockSathi-1-7]. The festive blog post has no impact [StockSathi-1-8].

ShelfMitra's purchase-order approval feature targets multi-store chains rather than single kirana stores [ShelfMitra-1-4], and all its open roles are in Mumbai [ShelfMitra-1-5][ShelfMitra-1-6]. Its Starter and Growth prices are baseline only [ShelfMitra-1-1][ShelfMitra-1-2], so the threat stays low.

BahiBook's first recorded Solo and Plus prices are a baseline with no week-on-week change [BahiBook-1-1], its GST rounding fix is low impact [BahiBook-1-2], and its single open role is in Pune [BahiBook-1-3]. Its 50,000-user base is reported only in Maharashtra, with no evidence of Kolkata presence [BahiBook-1-4], so the threat stays low.

recommendations.action: Prepare Sales talking points for Kolkata prospects comparing StockSathi's ₹499 Basic and ₹999 Pro, both with GST billing.
Review StockSathi's 2G sync and dark mode launches against the product roadmap; no change is needed yet.
Check ShelfMitra's hiring snapshots for any listings outside Mumbai before changing its threat rating.

watchlist: Whether BahiBook's Maharashtra user growth reaches other regions [BahiBook-1-4].
StockSathi's festive stocking checklist blog is an early content signal with no measured impact [StockSathi-1-8].
Any new city listings in ShelfMitra's careers snapshots beyond its Mumbai roles [ShelfMitra-1-5][ShelfMitra-1-6].
discounted_claims: Unverified: ShelfMitra's careers header describes it as expanding east, but no eastern roles are listed this week [ShelfMitra-1-7].
